description_en: Queries the backup information of a PolarDB cluster
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.help_en:
The backup status. Valid values:
Success: The backup is complete.
Failed: The backup failed
parameters.help_zh:
备份状态，取值范围如下：
Success：备份完成
Failed：备份失败
parameters.name: backup_status

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values: 
Automated: automatic backup.
Manual: manual backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值范围如下： 
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The destination region for cross-region backups.

Currently, only PolarDB for MySQL supports this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域备份的目的地域。

当前仅PolarDB MySQL版支持该参数
parameters.name: backup_region

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 
30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围如下： 
30
50
100

默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Set the value to an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值范围为大于0但不超过Integer最大值的整数，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of this backup (UTC)
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间（UTC时间）。

BackupMethod.description_en: The data backup method. Only snapshot backups are supported. The value is fixed as Snapshot
BackupMethod.description_zh: 数据备份方法，仅支持快照备份，取值固定为Snapshot

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values: 
Automated: automatic backup.
Manual: manual backup
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式，取值范围如下： 
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

BackupSetSize.description_en:
The size of the backup file. Unit: bytes.

Because data blocks are shared between snapshots, the space released after you delete a snapshot backup is much smaller than the size of the backup file. For more information, see [Backup FAQ]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164881.html）
BackupSetSize.description_zh:
备份文件大小，单位为Byte。

因为快照之间存在共享数据块，因此删除目标快照备份后释放的空间会远小于该备份文件的大小。更多详情，请参见[备份功能FAQ]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164881.html）

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of this backup (UTC)
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间（UTC时间）。

BackupStatus.description_en:
The backup status. Valid values:
Success: The backup is complete.
Failed: The backup failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份状态，取值范围如下：
Success：备份完成
Failed：备份失败

BackupType.description_en: The backup type. Only full backups are supported. The value is fixed as FullBackup
BackupType.description_zh: 备份类型，仅支持全量备份，取值固定为FullBackup

BackupsLevel.description_en:
The backup set level. Valid values:
Level-1: level-1 backup.
Level-2: level-2 backup
BackupsLevel.description_zh:
备份集级别，取值范围如下：
Level-1：一级备份
Level-2：二级备份

ConsistentTime.description_en: The point in time of the consistent snapshot. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
ConsistentTime.description_zh: 一致性快照的时间点，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为秒

ExpectExpireTime.description_en: The expected expire time of the backup set. This parameter is supported only for instances with sparse backup enabled
ExpectExpireTime.description_zh: 备份集预期过期时间（仅支持开启稀疏备份的实例）

ExpectExpireType.description_en: The expected expire type of the backup set. This parameter is supported only for instances with sparse backup enabled
ExpectExpireType.description_zh: 备份集预期过期类型（仅支持开启稀疏备份的实例）

IsAvail.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set is available. Valid values:
0: unavailable.
1: available
IsAvail.description_zh:
备份集是否可用，取值范围如下：
0：不可用
1：可用

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of records on the current page

TotalLevel2BackupSize.description_en:
The total size of level-2 backups in the specified region. Unit: bytes.
Only PSL4 and PSL5 storage types are supported.
Only clusters with the level-2 backup feature enabled are supported.
If this parameter is not returned, the level-2 backup size is 0
TotalLevel2BackupSize.description_zh:
指定地域的二级备份总大小，单位为 Byte。
仅支持存储类型 PSL4 和 PSL5。
仅支持开启二级备份功能的集群。
若没有返回说明二级备份大小为0
